About Us

Creating celebrations with heart and style

At Soul Decor & Events, we believe every occasion tells a story. Our team blends creative design with seamless coordination to deliver events that feel personal, polished, and truly memorable.

Whether it is a wedding, a birthday, a baby shower, or a festive celebration, we bring dedication, warmth, and an eye for detail that turns ideas into reality.

What We Do

Services we offer

Comprehensive event solutions designed to make your special day stress-free and spectacular.

Wedding Planning

From venue selection to decor and catering coordination, we design weddings that reflect your unique love story.

Corporate Events

Professional conferences, product launches, and team celebrations executed with precision and brand alignment.

Birthday Parties

Themed decor, entertainment planning, and joyful setups for birthdays that guests of all ages will remember.

Decoration & Design

Custom balloon arrangements, stage setups, lighting design, and ambient decor tailored to your theme and venue.
